featured_reviews.review_text:
I have in past serviced my car with GoMechanic and my experience was really good. Hence I opted again for a service with you guys but this time my experience was horrible.
I was called by my service buddy and he said the car needed some additional work by adding some sensors. I found this fishy and i went to the workshop myself.
When I further inspected there was no such additional work and he was simply trying to increase my bill. Apart from this they didn't not service my car even after saying the service is done they hadn't added battery water and even the car cleaning was not done properly. In the end they didn't provide me with free wiper blades which i had opted for saying they aren't available. The behaviour of the service buddy was pathetic. He refused to drop my car back and also demanded the payment for the service on another number and refused to pay via GoMechanic app. I haven't yet got the bill for my service as well.

featured_reviews.name: Ashwini Agrawal
featured_reviews.review_text:
This garage disappointed in multiple ways. Excellent experience with Chandan Auto Works. The work on my car was done honestly, professionally, and at a very reasonable rate.

Mr. Prasanjit is extremely humble, cooperative, and transparent in his approach. What I appreciated most was his honesty  instead of unnecessarily replacing the shock absorbers, he clearly explained their actual condition and advised accordingly. Finding such genuine guidance in car servicing is rare nowadays.

He regularly shared WhatsApp updates along with photos of the damaged parts and explained the issues properly, which built a lot of trust and confidence. The quotation was also very professional and clearly detailed.

Special appreciation to his workers as well  they are skilled, hardworking, and handled the car with care and sincerity. The entire team works in a very coordinated and professional manner.

Overall, a very reliable and trustworthy garage with a customer-friendly and professional approach. Highly recommended!

featured_reviews.name: ivm shops
featured_reviews.review_text:
Was on the hunt for a solid, trustworthy shop to get a full service done on my BMW 3 Series GT. The car had clocked close to 100k km, and it wasn’t just a basic service, I’m talking full suspension overhaul, gear and differential oil change, some body panel paintwork, plus the steering had a bit of play and needed alignment.

I spotted an ad on Facebook and ended up connecting with Anuj from AutoMed 360. We had a quick chat, ran through everything, and he actually arranged a pickup and drop-off for the car right in Navi Mumbai, Smooth and super convenient for me.

Honestly, the whole experience was top-notch. Pricing was fair, I would’ve paid at least double at an official BMW service center.

What really stood out was that these guys are official suppliers for a bunch of legit European and OEM parts. So you're not running around looking for components, it’s all handled in-house.

If you’ve got a luxury car and need proper service without the dealership markup, AutoMed 360’s the spot.

featured_reviews.name: Rakesh Pillai
featured_reviews.review_text:
The experience was really good.. it is always a good feeling to see your car getting serviced in front of your eyes. Automed360 is really professional in terms of explaining what all will get changed along with brands and costs.

Really happy with the service. Keep up the good work guys.
